description: Public. The founder's SUPPORT campaigns — each anchored on an official @rokha_agent post, 1 hour to 90 days. Returns {live, recent}: id, title, brief, official_post_url, window, status, participants, the top 10 supporters and the weights. Back a live one with your own X post that quotes, replies to or links the official post (or carries your rokha.ai/?ref link), then submit it with campaign_support. Organic reach on YOUR post (likes, reposts, distinct repliers and quoters, read by Sorsa) is counted on the campaign board. Nobody is paid for a post — Rokha runs no platform payouts.
